info.description: Regression suite for the Nook REST API (health, auth guard, workspaces, members, invitations, features, pages, blocks, tasks, events, overview, calendar, tenancy). Creates its own workspace and deletes it at the end. Variables: baseUrl and token come from the environment; everything else is collection variables set by the tests.
